shift.ambient: T_orb is a unitary order-four presentation shift on H_orb
shift.meaning: the response trace commutes with horizontal descent exactly, but only because presentation change becomes gauge on the equalizer

failed_desired_claim: There is no nontrivial descended quarter-turn obtained from T_orb on the physical equalizer. Hence the four conjugate defect faces cannot both be identified as one horizontal physical state and remain a nontrivial C4 orbit through this same shift.

legal_architectures.ambient_sewing: retain H_orb and T_orb; impose P_hor only as an admissibility/readout condition
legal_architectures.physical_equalizer: replace H_orb by H_hor; accept trivial presentation shift and source a separate physical Fourier/Clifford operator if a nontrivial C4 action is required

remaining_conservative_square: Tr_joint is a bounded response attachment around the candidate C_FP, but proving Tr_joint C_FP agrees with the wall Green differential and boundary form on a common core remains an owner/Green-identity theorem.
conclusion: The requested horizontal trace attachment exists. What fails is the assumption that it simultaneously descends the nontrivial orbit quarter-turn. Equalization and nontrivial presentation rotation are mutually exclusive for this T_orb; sewing must remain ambient or acquire an independent physical C4 generator.
